abstention_contract: explicit measured/transferred/missing; no interpolation across missing; raw/G4 validity; chroma guide and representative mean supported; zero-noise identity; smoothstep inward16; no added mean compensation
candidate_scope: reference, E, E-P and factorial stable-support/balanced reconstruction; only E full-image timing at 8 threads
context_control_rule: stable-balanced only, no structure guard; requested margins64/128 clipped to image; P profile fixed; representative Y frozen to original24px padded field; same interior; context timings not in variant benchmarks
measures: Haar HH MAD (Y and Co/Cg) and mid-band (Gaussian 1 - 4) MAD ratios output/input on the inner zone; mid-band Y correlation; mean drifts; correlation of the removed |dY| with the smoothed input gradient (high = structure removed). No clean reference: no MAE/PSNR.

noise_profile_calibration.scope: R6 Mark III pairs; transfer to R7 and 60D remains experimental

profile_support_rule: exploratory: Y G2 gradient/HH <= 1, <=1% Y outside (0,1), >=16 eligible 32px tiles, per-plane q75/q25 <=2 and q25>1e-7; interpolate binary support, fading toward missing bins, no nearest-bin fill. G-structure multiplies by 1/(1+(G2 gradient/Y HH)^4). Not a probability or RCD synthetic simulation; gating can make spatial seams and change means.

structure_guard_rule: minimum retained correction across own plane and Y; max(|x-G1|/sigmaFine,|G1-G4|/sigmaMid); retained 1 below3, smoothstep to0 at6; heuristic, not probability; zero sigma abstains; symmetric exchange weights; no spatial dilation
support_experiment_contract: baseline abstention_contract applies to E and E-P only; stable variants use finite input and G4-supported domain, not raw brightness availability; representative chroma level still required; balanced variants use symmetric exchanges r=w*(G16(w)*d-G16(w*d)), preserving whole-field sum up to rounding, not every ROI
